summary: Contribution by Kristian Muri Knausgård. Derived from Bei Yi's beiyi-ten-d250-t022 (2026-11-09), building on Rishi Khan's TEN certificate, Samuel Lavery's agent team's OpethN/am-cert/bridge-port, R. Arun Chandru's master-of-puppets series, Yuhang Shi's refinements, ajp88's window work, the Zeta Lab bridge, Anthropic's Zeta23 library and Knausgård's Lean developments for arXiv:2609.33043 and arXiv:2610.08965. Carries over the terminal H_W enclosure from knausgard-ten-hw50-order36: AMW.taylorN_F uses Complex.exp_bound with n := 36; the rational bounds for sqrt(2)/2, cos(sqrt(2)/2), sin(sqrt(2)/2) and the H_W floor use denominator 10^50 instead of 10^42. The improved floor is propagated to the final exact bound. Window coefficients, certificate data, tree, root cover and certificate checker are unchanged. Upstream copyright, license and attribution notices are retained.
method: Order-36 Taylor enclosure and H_W rational-floor refinement of Bei Yi's beiyi-ten-d250-t022 (denominator 10^50; TEN certificate unchanged)
